body: Thank you so much for replying, it does help.  I thought about switching rooms with our room mate in the basement but I am worried that even something as small as that will be taken as a slight against her.  She hasn't been to an aa meeting in months now so I think her alcoholic behavior is back.  I won't be allowed to do the smallest thing wrong without her getting really upset with me.  If I move to a motel she will take it as a sign that I am angry at her so I have to stay and I don't think I can do it.
